title: Requirements for sprinklers in an existing house
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)
code_edition: 2012 BC Building Code; original construction reportedly under 1998 BC Building Code

facts.text: An existing unsprinklered house was built in 2002 as a single-family dwelling and is four storeys in building height. An unauthorized additional dwelling unit was later built; the proposal is to add about 3 m² and legalize/renovate the additional unit.
The parties agreed the original house was under the 1998 BCBC Part 9 but did not provide evidence that its Section 2.5 equivalency path had been used.
The local authority considered the Part 3 sprinkler provisions applicable; the appellant cited impracticality/cost and argued life safety would not be reduced.
